question.text: Which one of the following methods is used to prepare Me $_{3}$ COEt with a good yield?

options.text: Heating a mixture of $(1 ; 1)$ EtOH and $\mathrm{Me}_{3} \mathrm{COH}$ in the presence of conc. $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$

solution.text:
\(\mathrm{Me}_{3} \mathrm{CONa} \underset{\left(1^{\circ} \text { alkyl halide) }\right.}{\stackrel{\mathrm{EtCl}}{\longrightarrow}} \mathrm{Me}_{3} \mathrm{COEt}\)
This reaction is known as Williamson's synthesis.
So, the correct option is B
